text:
marina_cs: Hi team — customer acct_7421 just hit their trial credits and says they couldn't finish a big integration test because a 401 auth error caused retries. Credits showed as expired automatically while the job was running. They also say a promo code (PROMO50) failed to apply at the time. Can billing confirm whether auto-expiry happened mid-request or after?

sam_billing: looking now. Do we have the request window + charge logs? If it expired exact second it might be policy but we sometimes make one-off reinstatements.

marina_cs: pasted the relevant timeline they sent: `2025-11-02T15:04:12Z` first failed auth, repeated retries until `2025-11-02T15:07:30Z`. Trial credit balance snapshot at `2025-11-02T15:05:01Z` showed 0 and then account was throttled. Customer says promo code returned "invalid_code" when they tried to apply it during the retries.

ivan_eng: quick note — infra logs show a short auth outage 15:04:10–15:04:18 affecting our token service in region eu-west-1. That caused 401s for a subset of requests. Not sure about promo apply path; that's a billing/time-of-apply check.

jess_ops: tagging @sam_billing — if the auth outage caused excess retries that consumed trial tokens faster than expected we might treat this as a platform-caused loss. Policy question: do we reinstate trial credits when loss is due to our service outage?

sam_billing: policy summary: trials expire on the scheduled date/time. We have discretion to issue goodwill credits for platform incidents. For promo codes, system applies them at checkout; if code validation failed with `invalid_code` because of transient billing API error, we can re-run validation and apply retroactively in many cases. Need approval for manual grant + promo reapply.

marina_cs: customer is asking for full trial reinstatement for the week plus retroactive application of PROMO50. They were load-testing and this blocked a demo to their board tomorrow. They are on the free tier.

autopromo-bot: Promo check for acct_7421 — PROMO50 status: last attempted apply `2025-11-02T15:05:12Z` -> response `code_invalid`. No later successful attempts.

ivan_eng: internal suggestion: if we grant a small trial top-up (e.g., 5k tokens) and re-apply PROMO50 for the customer, we should also flag this account so we don't auto-sweep credits for 48h while CS verifies.

sam_billing: I can approve a one-time 5k token credit and manual promo apply pending a short note in the billing ticket. Policy owner sign-off not required for <10k token goodwill grants. I'll do the adjustment and timestamp it.

marina_cs: amazing, thank you. I'll let the customer know and ask them to retry the demo after we confirm. Can you paste the billing transaction IDs here when done? :pray:

sam_billing: Will do — will update in this thread and the Zendesk ticket #Z-99872 once complete. ETA 20–30m.

ivan_eng: i'll also open a follow-up bug to add a safe-guard so trial expiry doesn't trigger mid-request during auth-side outages. Filed: INF-4432.

marina_cs: closing loop for now. If billing completes the manual apply, i'll confirm with customer and mark resolved. Thanks everyone. :tada:
